tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dus 'khor tshogs mchod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ 'dir dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i tshogs mchod mdor bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang ma 'brel ba'i skabs yin na/ yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas/ nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas pa dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byin rlabs/ zhu 'bul/ skyabs sems yig brgya rnams dkyil chog dang sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byed pa las/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nyer gnas mdzod// ces pas gsol 'debs zhu 'bul byed pa ni khyad par ro/ /de nas bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs nas/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i bar rgyas bsdus ji ltar sgom kyang rung ste/ bzlas pa'i bar du bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor bsgoms na rang la nye bar bsdu'o/ /mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dbus su/ nang mchod kyis chos 'byung thig le dang bcas pa 'bri ba'am/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dang bris sku sogs yod na maṇ+ḍal ma byas kyang chog gang ltar yang bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa rnam bcu dbang ldan gyi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ 'byung bzhi ri rab la brten zhing srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du chud pa/ khor yug chen po lngas yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal med khang lha'i gdan dang bcas pa*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa dang bcas pa de nyid du grub par gyur pa ni/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje'i bdag / ces pa nas bzung*/ bstod chen yongs rdzogs 'don pa'am/ thugs dkyil tsam byed na/ yid rab 'dzin pa rnams la 'dud/ / ces pa'i rjes su/ khyod kyi srid pa gsum las 'das kyang sogs sbyar/ de nas/ bdag nyid kyi thugs kar hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ zhes pa nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhi/ zhes pa'i bar ye shes dgug gzhug bya/

slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa zhes mgron spyan 'dren pa nas/ khyod la 'dud de khyod la 'dud/ / ces pa'i dkyil 'khor lhag gnas skabs kyi mchod pa dang 'dra ba las/ thugs dkyil tsam byed na/ oṃ ṣa ḍaṃ ga ya na maḥ zhes pa'i rjes su/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yo na mo na maḥ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor chog ltar gtor ma 'bul ba yan chan bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba'i skabs kyi tshogs mchod yin na/ gtor ma 'bul ba yan chad dkyil chog ltar song ba'i rjes su/ tshogs rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa man chad kyi chog ste/ de yang bdag 'jug mi byed pa'am byed kyang de'i sngon du tshogs 'khor byed na/ gtor chog sngon du len dgos so/ /de nas tshogs rdzas la nang mchod 'thor bzhin du/ oṃ phreṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dhā twī shwa rī ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba dra bye bi shwa dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi bi shwa dha ya hūṃ phreṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun brjod/ tshogs rdzas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ na mo thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po/ rang bzhin rnam par dag pa skye ba med pa mtshan nyid rnam par dag pa ā li kā li'-i/ ngo bo rnam par dag pa sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas rgyas btab pa 'di nyid/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /oṃ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūṃ/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams la zhes dang*/ 'phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams la zhes dang*/ dam tshig gi rtsa ba mched grogs rdo rje spun grogs rnams la zhes 'don pa spo/ oṃ mi 'bral snying gi gzhal med khang*/ /mos gus gzhom med pho brang na/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog

/bka' drin mnyam med dam pa rje/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' la sprin bzhin 'thib/ / 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /gnas khang 'di la byin phob la/ / tshogs rdzas 'di la bcud cig chug /'dir 'dus rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ / mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ /rnam dag bde chen 'gyur med dngos/ / bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dus kyi 'khor lo rdo rje sems/ / mkha' khyab dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /rnam 'phrul mkha' sogs/ spros bral dag pa e yig dbyibs/ /rnam kun mchog ldan mkha' spyod gnas/ /'khor lo'i bdag mo sna tshogs yum/ /dbyings phyug shes rab pha rol phyin/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ rnam gsum srid pa'i gnas kyi mchog /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten sprul sku'i zhing*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems khro bo'i gtso/ /dkyil 'khor lha mo'i tshogs bcas kyang*/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ rnal 'byor ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /'chi med gdengs can lha min skyes/ /'khor ba gnas 'gyur ye shes kyi/ /srid gsum lha tshogs thams cad kyang*/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnam 'phrul mchog /chos rgyal rigs ldan 'khor bcas dang*/ /rtsod ldan dus 'dir rdo rje 'chang*/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kun yang*/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ sa la spyod pa'i 'og min mchog /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad gnas mchog nas/ /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yang*/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ gang la gang 'dul skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /phyag brnyan pho nya 'byung po'i tshogs/ /rnam 'phrul sogs / bdud tshogs kun 'dul 'phrin las zhing*/ /dur khrod chen po bcu drug nas/ /bgegs 'joms 'dod don kun sgrub pa/ /chos skyong bstan srung tshogs rnams kyang*/ /rnam 'phrul sogs/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rigs gyi cod pan ldems se ldem/

/dar gyi cod pan pur ru ru/ /rgyan cha mang po khral la la/ /rol mo mang po dir ri ri/ / glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug /'khor tshogs 'bum sde shar ra ra/ /sgyu ma'i rang snang rjen ne ne/ /gtad med rig pa sal la la/ /brjod med dbyings du thal la la/ /bde ba chen po khril li li/ /byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol/ /gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la/ /sgrub mchog bdag la dngos sgrub stsol/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol/ /'khor gsum gnyis su med par rol/ / tshigs bcad so so'i mthar rol mo'i sgra bya'o/ /de nas phud dang po bcad la/ gtor ma la yang cung zad sgron/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi sprul pa dang/ /phyogs dus kun gyi mchod rdzas bzang rgu rnams/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ / mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ / de nas las kyi rdo rjes lag pa g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung*/ g.yas rtse gsum gyi phyag rgyas ka pa la thogs te/ steng 'og kha sbyor gyi tshul gyis bzung la/ kyai/ 'dir ni chos rnams bzang pos ltos/ /'dus pa rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du rol/ / zhes tshogs kyi gtso bo nas brtsams te rim pas bskor/ so sos kyang*/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med/ /'dod chags la sogs dri ma bral/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba/ /de bzhin nyid la bdag phyag 'tshal/ / zhes blang*/ slar de tshogs rdzas gzhan rnams la bsre/ yang phud gcig bcad de/ phyed sngar gyi phud dang bsre/ phyed lhag gtor la bsre ba'i phyir logs su bzhag go /da lta lag len la 'di ltar byed pa ltar bkod pa yin zhing*/ 'grub na tshogs rdzas so sor drangs nas/ slar so so'i phud bsdus nas 'bul bar bya'o/ / snga phyi lhan cig tu bsngo ba ni/ zhal zas ro brgya sogs dang*/ dus kyi 'khor lo srung ma drug bcu'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/

chos skyong chen po rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ 'byung po spyi dang*/ yul bdag grong bdag gzhi bdag rnams la gtor mchod nas 'byung ba'i gtor sngags tsam gyis phul/ mthar/ dman pa'i yul las rab 'das shing*/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam tshig mchog /dngos grub kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /bdud rtsi mchog gi mchog par bgyi/ /sgrib pa'i dri ma kun sel zhing*/ /rtog pa kun las nges grol ba/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub sems/ /bde ba chen pos mnyes gyur cig / ces brjod/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na/ gtor sngags tsam gyis phul ba'i mthar/ dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ na maḥ 'i mtha' can gyi mchod sngags chen mos 'bul/ yang na/ na maḥ 'i mchod sngags gyi tshab tu/ sku bzhi rdo rje bzhi yi bdag nyid dang*/ /tshad med rnam thar chos gyi phung po dang*/ /dam chos ston pa 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams te/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul/ /dus 'khor rdor sems shākya thub pa dang*/ /nus ma bum pa bcu dang rdo rje bzhi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dang khro bo'i rgyal/ /rang rang lha mor bcas pa rnams la mchod/ /gzungs ma rnal 'byor ma dang 'dod ma dang*/ /chos kyi lha dang gdeng can phyir 'dod ma/ / rab gtum gza' skar phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs/ /phyed bcas bye ba gsum gyi 'byung po mchod/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas dang*/ /mchod yul rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par 'bul/ /'gro kun ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho la/ /mchog tu rol bas bde chen thob par shog / ces pa tsam brjod kyang rung*/ bsdus pa'i skabs gtor sngags kho nas chog go /so sos phud bcad nas/ oṃ āḥgu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥbadz+ra nai bi te hūṃ/ chang bu gnyis byas/ oṃ ha ri t+yai piṇ+ḍa ki pra tits+tsha swāhā/ yang chang bu gsum pa byas la/ oṃ sarba dū tī ke/ a grā gra saṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de nas nang gi sbyin sreg gi dmigs pa gsal btab la so sor longs spyod/

lhag ma bsdus la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lhag ma'i gtor ma bzang zhing rgya che ba 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs dang*/ oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi u ts+tshiṣ+ta ba liṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ta bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa swāhā/ lan gsum rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir btang*/ drag sngags kyis mtshams bcad/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma dang lhag gtor lhan cig gtong ba'i lag len yod pa ltar byas kyang rung*/ de nas rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni dril bu'i sgra dang bcas/ kol+la e ri ṭa ṭhi ā bo lā/ /mum+mu ṇi ri kak+ko la/ /gha ṇai kri bi tra ho badz+dza i/ /ka ru ṇi ki a i ṇa ro lā/ /tā hiṃ bā la khādz+dza ī/ /gā ḍeṃ ma a ṇā bidz+dza a i/ /ha le ka liñtsa ra pa ṇi a i/ /du dhu ra badz+dzi a i/ /tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ /ka pu ri la i a i/ /mā la in+dha na sā liṃ dza/ /ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ /phreṃ kha ṇa khe ṭa ka ran+te/ /shud+dha a shud+dha ṇ+ṇa ma ni a i/ /ni raṃ su aṃ ga tsa ḍa bi/ /ta hiṃ dza sa rā bā pa ṇi a i/ /ma la a tsi kun+du ru ba ḍa i/ /ḍiṇa ḍi ma ta hiṃ na badz+dza a i/ / zhes brjod/ lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa lnga sregs shing*/ /spyan ma mig la sogs pa dag /sregs pa'i ri bong can haṃ 'dzag / ces brjod cing don sgom/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs bkra shis dang*/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ / de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog / ces smon lam btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang 'brel ba yin na/ de'i rjes chog kho nas chog ma 'brel na yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ slar yang smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa gtor chog bzhin du bya'o/

/dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel bar tshogs mchod shin tu bsdus pa byed na/ zhu 'bul dor zhing*/ mdun bskyed rgyas pa'ang mi dgos pas/ mgron spyan 'dren man chad byed pa las/ mchod pa'i tshigs bcad kyang dor/ nang mchod 'bul ba yang mchod sngags tsam gyis chog go/ skyabs sems yig brgya rnams kyang bsdus pa dang*/ bdag bskyed kyang lhan skyes sam dpa' bo gcig pa kho na la brten par bya'o/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag rgyas pa/ rgyud 'grel rnams dang rdo rje 'dzin pa gong ma rnams kyis rgyas par gsungs pa las rtogs par bya zhing*/ mdo tsam zhig gzhan du 'bri bar yang 'dod do/ /de ltar na tshogs mchod kyi cho ga bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhes bya ba 'di yang*/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //maṅga laṃ/ dus 'khor tshogs mchod bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bzhugs/mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ - PAGE 222 -- PAGE 223 -- PAGE 217 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
